close_reason: Wrapped install_default_drivers in OnceLock::get_or_init; called at most once per process
description: db_pool.rs calls sqlx::any::install_default_drivers() at the start of try_open_any_pool(). This function is not idempotent — calling it multiple times is harmless only by accident of current sqlx implementation. More importantly, it registers drivers globally and is supposed to be called once at program startup. Calling it on every pool open means any concurrent callers race on the global driver registry. Move the call to a once_cell::sync::Once or LazyLock and call it once per process.
title: core: db_pool::try_open_any_pool calls install_default_drivers on every invocation
